title: Idle timeouts
hints: A connection whose client never speaks keeps a goroutine (and a file descriptor) busy forever. conn.SetReadDeadline makes a blocked read fail once the deadline passes.
A deadline is a point in time, not a duration. Setting it once when the connection opens limits the whole conversation, not each pause.
Before every read, call conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(s.Idle)). When the read fails, return, and the deferred Close hangs up.
